lines:
Project-local SQLite persistence for versioned reusable QA job definitions, links to design specifications and tasks, tags, immutable execution groups, and append-only per-job evidence. Job-definition versions protect overlapping edits; uniquely identified evidence appends do not serialize unrelated runs. Current state is derived from latest evidence plus staleness.

Approved Markdown extension (implementation pending): Add markdown to QA designSpecificationLinks and designExternalIds selection semantics, canonical reference validation, title resolution, retrieval and reverse backlinks. Reuse shared target resolution with task links; preserve ordering, job versions, evidence history and existing execution behavior. Title/file-path edits do not break references. Do not delete linked documents or silently unlink QA jobs; require explicit guarded dependency edits. Desktop QA pickers/navigation and backend conversions must preserve these references. Runtime conformance and native/MCP workflows verify that referenced prose is the exact stored specification.

data.name: QA Store and Run Evidence
data.technology: SQLite, per-job versions, immutable run evidence
